guide: Open Start and type your business name, the cash at the bank, your cash floor, the days to release a deposit and your credit limit in the yellow cells.
Record each deposit or card hold in Deposits with its release due date; Holds to Release then ranks the held ones by date.
Record every payment in Payments with its date, booking, channel, kind and method; Cash In by Day and Payment Methods fill in by themselves.
Record each marketplace payout in Payouts with the booking value, fee, expected payout and date; the difference and days late fill in.
Use Payout Reconciliation each month to see every gap, and the Marketplace Payout Reconciliation tool to name what to chase.
Record each corporate invoice in Invoices; the balance, days overdue and age band fill in, and Ageing Buckets adds them up.
Write each promise to pay in Promises to Pay and follow the next step it shows.
Count the cash each day in Daily Till Log; the cash expected comes from the cash payments of the day.
Check Deposit Liability each month end and the Four-Week Cash Forecast each week against your cash floor.
Use Kept Deposits to check that every amount kept is backed by fees or a claim amount.
Use the 18 tools for the weekly decisions, print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and tap a message link to send a text with the details already written in.
Read the Payments Dashboard and the charts every week. A one-car host uses the same sheets with one vehicle and one channel.

listing.title: Car Rental Deposits, Payments and Payouts Excel Template: Deposit Tracker, Payout Reconciliation, Invoice Chase, Cash Forecast
listing.headline: See every hold, payout and unpaid invoice of your car rental in one place
listing.description:
Run the money side of a small car and van rental in one Excel workbook. Built for an owner-operator, a manager who also does billing and a part-time bookkeeper, and useful to a one-car host. Deposits holds every deposit or card hold with its release date, the amount kept or refunded and the liability held now. Payments records every payment by method, kind and channel, and Payouts compares each marketplace payout with the expected amount.

Invoices tracks corporate account invoices with balance, days overdue and an ageing band, Promises to Pay records what accounts promised, and Invoice Lines splits an invoice into rental, fees and damage. Deposit Liability, Payout Reconciliation, Fee Share by Month, Cash In by Day, Daily Till Log, Cash Forecast and Card Hold Calendar are worked out for you from the ledgers.

18 tools answer the weekly questions: which holds to release, which payouts are short or late, which account to chase first, whether cash holds above your floor and whether the till balances. Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready text messages to renters, accounts, a marketplace, the manager, the bookkeeper and the accountant.

This is part four of the Car Rental Business suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, with a demo copy full of sample data to explore first. Renters appear by first name and initial, a booking reference and dates only. It helps you keep track of your money and does not promise results. Check your local rules for deposits, records and tax; confirm tax questions with your adviser.

ar.Currency symbol: type it once in the \"C: رمز العملة: اكتبه مرة واحدة في خانة «رمز العملة» ضمن الإعدادات أدناه (الافتراضي $). يظهر في المبالغ المكتوبة داخل النصوص وبجانب المبالغ في لوحة المؤشرات والأدوات.

ar.Google Sheets: upload this file to Googl: Google Sheets: ارفع هذا الملف إلى Google Drive وافتحه باستخدام Google Sheets؛ كل شيء يُحسب هناك أيضاً. قفل الأوراق لا ينتقل إلى Google Sheets، لذا اكتب في خلايا الإدخال فقط.
